answers.how: Measured the red ball diameter at t=0.2s as 51.5 px in 1280x720 coordinates (scale = 7 cm / 51.5 px = 0.1359 cm/px) and tracked vertical position around Frame 5 (t=0.208s) to find a speed of ~180 px/s, converting to 24.5 cm/s.

Scaled the pixel-to-cm ratio to t=0.6s using the depth ratio (1.1510 m / 1.0995 m) and measured ball diameter (~0.145 cm/px), then measured the ball displacement between Frames 13, 14, and 16 to get a speed of ~285 px/s, converting to 41.5 cm/s.

Fitted the vertical trajectory across Frames 2, 3, 5, 6, and 7 around the lower turnaround point near t=0.2s to obtain an upward acceleration of ~3680 px/s^2, and converted using the scale 0.1359 cm/px at t=0.2s to get 500 cm/s^2.

Using the camera scale calibrated from the 7 cm ball at 1.0995 m and scaling to the person's shoulder depth (mean 1.2528 m from 1.2750 m left and 1.2305 m right), the person's shoulder breadth corresponds to 44.0 cm.
